text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: In fact, it's nothing. I can still run, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But why? I just need to kiss it better and be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Things like this are a part of everyday life back in my hometown.
choice_data_list: If you don't take care, it may come back to haunt you later.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmph… Okay, if you insist. I wouldn't wanna have to miss a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After tending to her injury, I give Oguri Cap the rest of the day off to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I got hurt like this all the time back when I used to run in the woods.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… maybe it does hurt a little, now that I think of it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I didn't even notice it earlier. That's not a good sign.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After tending to her injury, I give Oguri Cap the rest of the day off to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If you told me to leap up onto a cliff, I might struggle a little, but still…
choice_data_list: What kind of example is that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's just the sort of solo training I used to do back in the day. As long as I don't have to do that, I should be okay to continue.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Come on. Let's give it another go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After tending to her injury, I comply with Oguri Cap's request to resume training.
